trust_decision.summary: Whether the acting admin user holds VIEW on the resource's security context (e.g. sulu.webspaces.<key>) before a public, unauthenticated preview token is minted or revoked for it; at the pinned commit no one decides this, and the fix decides it in PreviewLinkManager::generate()/revoke().

landing_point.why: The summary says 'creating preview links'; the POST /admin/api/preview-links/{id}?action=generate handler is the obvious entry, and it hands straight to the manager.

fix_sites.module_kind: application service (manager), lower-level API than the controller

fix_sites.entry_point: constructor gains optional SecurityCheckerInterface (fix.diff:23) plus new private checkViewPermission (fix.diff:70-80)
DI wiring of sulu_preview.preview_link_manager; injects sulu_security.security_checker (fix.diff:90)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/Sulu/Bundle/PreviewBundle/Application/Manager/PreviewLinkManager.php:32-85 (fix lives in the manager service, not the controller) plus wiring in src/Sulu/Bundle/PreviewBundle/Resources/config/services.php:88-94

O3_reason_to_dismiss: GET /preview-links/{id} only reads a link that someone authorised already created, and the admin live preview (/admin/preview/*) is an internal editor iframe, not a 'public preview link', so both look outside an advisory about creating links.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Users with VIEW (not necessarily EDIT) must still generate links (201); the public token routes must stay unauthenticated; resources whose provider returns a null security context, and setups without the security bundle (null checker), must keep working. An over-broad fix that demands EDIT, puts auth on the public render, or throws on a null context breaks these.

O7_producer.where: src/Sulu/Bundle/PreviewBundle/Resources/config/services.php:88-94 (the checker has to be injected here, otherwise the null-guard at fix.diff:72 skips the check without any error); the security context itself comes from the mapper src/Sulu/Bundle/PageBundle/Preview/PageObjectProvider.php:108-113, which the check does call

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /admin/api/preview-links/{resourceId}?resourceKey&locale returns the existing link with its public token, with no VIEW check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Read-only; the link was created by an authorised user; the advisory is about creating links
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point, different action, bypasses the manager entirely

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Admin live preview start/render/update/update-context loads and renders any resource by id for any logged-in admin user, with no VIEW check on its security context
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Internal editor iframe behind the admin login, not a public link; a different controller and service (Preview.php)
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another controller plus src/Sulu/Bundle/PreviewBundle/Preview/Preview.php:42-56, same bundle; no security-checker dependency in its wiring (services.php:97-104)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Page object-level permissions (per-page ACL, SecurityBehavior + id) are not checked; the fix checks only the webspace context and locale, unlike PageController
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The advisory and its test speak only of webspace/role permissions; object ACLs look like a neighbouring feature
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other bundle (PageBundle); a HOW-type gap that needs SecurityCondition objectType/objectId understood

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second preview object provider (e.g. snippets) whose getSecurityContext derives the context from a request option (webspaceKey) rather than the stored document, so the checked identity differs from what gets rendered
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: generate() stores arbitrary query options (PreviewLinkController.php:65-66) that the renderer consumes (PublicPreviewController.php:58-64); a maintainer could easily reuse options['webspaceKey'] instead of loading the document.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A regenerate/extend-link method on the manager or the repository create() path used by a CLI/cron route
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Link lifecycle features (expiry, regenerate) naturally land beside generate/revoke and would reach PreviewLinkRepository::create directly.

O9_family: missing authorization (CWE-862/863) on admin action that mints public access tokens

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8.x, composer, PHPUnit, Symfony kernel (Sulu TestBundle)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a VIEW check in PreviewLinkController::postTriggerAction for action=generate only, leaving revoke, GET and the manager API open.

out_of_scope_notes: PageObjectProvider::setValues uses a magic-call PropertyAccessor on client-supplied property paths in admin preview update (src/Sulu/Bundle/PageBundle/Preview/PageObjectProvider.php:53-72); not this advisory's protection.
PreviewVoter grants every attribute inside the preview kernel (src/Sulu/Bundle/PreviewBundle/Infrastructure/Symfony/Security/PreviewVoter.php:58-61); this is by design for rendering.
unverified: Whether an upstream firewall/listener restricts /admin/preview/* or /admin/api/preview-links by role; neither controller implements SecuredControllerInterface, but global access_control was not checked.
